messages:
Maya: quick question — planning a traffic migration from model-legacy -> model-v2 using the Console. goal: phased ramp with a small anchored traffic slice + automatic fallback to legacy on inference errors. want per-variant QPS caps and a final cutover window. ideas on how to express the anchoring + graceful fallback in the experiment config?

Alex: +1 for anchoring. i'd do hash_by=user_id and a 5% anchor for stability. also add a failure threshold rule that flips traffic back after X 5xxs or high latency.

Diego: agree. one implementation detail: we need to ensure prefix/KV cache compatibility when routing to v2 — cache warmup can bias metrics. consider a warmup phase where traffic to v2 is low but we prime the cache.

Sarah: telemetry question — what events do we capture to drive automatic rollback? latency p95, error-rate, and a model-quality eval signal (if available) maybe. we should tie alerts to experiment IDs so console dashboards show the rule that triggered the rollback.

Jon: for guard logic i propose a combination:
- absolute error count threshold (e.g. 20 errors / minute)
- relative degradation (p95 +20% vs baseline)
- consecutive host failures (circuit-breaker)
If any trigger fires, traffic moves 100% to fallback variant.

Priya: UX note — Console should show current traffic split, anchor owner list, and active guards inline. also allow manual override to pause ramp. small mock: "pause" button next to phase slider.

Maya: thanks. putting together a config snippet — does this look reasonable?
```yaml
experiment_id: migrate-v2-2026-03
hash_by: user_id
anchor_percent: 5
phases:
  - name: warmup
    target_percent: 1
    duration_minutes: 60
  - name: ramp
    target_percent: 50
    duration_minutes: 240
  - name: cutover
    target_percent: 100
guards:
  - type: absolute_errors
    limit_per_minute: 20
    fallback: model-legacy
  - type: p95_relative
    delta_pct: 20
    baseline_variant: model-legacy
    fallback: model-legacy
qps_caps:
  model-v2: 2000
  model-legacy: 5000
fallback_policy: immediate
metrics_hooks: [latency_p95, error_rate, inference_quality]
```

Alex: looks good. couple of tweaks: make warmup target_percent 2 (so.a bit more traffic to warm caches), and set a minimum evaluation window for p95 (like 5m) to avoid noisy rollbacks.

Diego: add a KV-cache-warmup flag so the runtime can prefill caches for v2 when phase starts. that avoids the cold-cache metric spike being mistaken for regressions.

Sarah: confirm metrics pipeline will attach experiment_id tags to spans and ingestion — otherwise dashboards can't filter. also add synthetic eval probes during warmup (small synthetic queries we know expected outputs for).

Priya: from Console UX POV, we need to surface the qps caps and guards inline and expose a small "simulate rollback" button so SEs can validate signals without impacting real traffic.

Maya: thanks all — i'll update the draft and create the Console experiment. will also attach a short runbook for on-call with steps: 1) pause ramp 2) force fallback 3) investigate metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: model-v2-canary -> cluster-canary-3 (id: dpl-7821)

console-bot: Experiment migrate-v2-2026-03 created (id: exp-9123). UI: /console/experiments/exp-9123

Jon: one more operational detail — ensure traffic anchoring respects GDPR opt-outs if hash_by=user_id. consider hashing by stable non-personal id where required.

Maya: good catch. we'll use anon_id when region == eu. adding to config before we run.

Alex: thumbs up. let us know when you want a quick rollout sync, happy to review telemetry dashboards. :thumbsup:

Maya: will do. thanks! :raised_hands:
